# Shared Morocco Adventures

> Small group, fixed date Morocco tours for solo travelers, couples and friends. Shared transport and shared riads keep prices low, with weekly departures from Marrakech and Fes, groups of up to 16 travelers, multi day tours from 135 EUR per person and day trips from 15 EUR.

Shared Morocco Adventures runs budget group tours to the Sahara Desert (Merzouga), the High Atlas, Chefchaouen, Fes and the imperial cities, plus shared day trips and airport transfers. Contact: sharedmoroccoadventures@gmail.com. Site: https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/

## Multi day group tours

From €219pp.

- [4-Day Sahara Desert Group Tour from Marrakech](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/tour-4-day-sahara-desert-group-tour.html): Join a small group for a 4-day shared tour from Marrakech to the Sahara — Ait Benhaddou, the Dades Gorges, a camel trek and desert camp. From €249pp.

## Day trips

- [Budget Day Trips from Fes](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/day-trips-fes.html): Shared, budget group day trips from Fes — Chefchaouen Blue City, Meknes & Volubilis, Ifrane cedar forest, and Sefrou & Bhalil. From €19pp.
- [Budget Day Trips from Marrakech](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/day-trips-marrakech.html): Shared, budget group day trips from Marrakech — medina walking tour, Ourika Valley, Agafay Desert, Essaouira, Ouzoud Falls and Ait Benhaddou. From €15pp.
- [10 Morocco Day Trips & Excursions](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/day-trips.html): Explore 10 small-group Morocco day trips from Marrakech and Fes: Sahara sunsets, Atlas Mountains, Chefchaouen, Essaouira, Ouzoud Falls and more. From €15.
- [Agafay Desert Sunset Day Trip](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-agafay-desert-sunset.html): A half/full-day shared trip from Marrakech to the Agafay stone desert — camel ride and golden-hour sunset, no overnight required. From €35pp.
- [Ait Benhaddou & Ouarzazate Day Trip](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-ait-benhaddou-ouarzazate.html): A full-day shared trip from Marrakech across the Tizi n'Tichka pass to the UNESCO kasbah of Ait Benhaddou and Ouarzazate's film studios. From €39pp.
- [Chefchaouen Blue City Day Trip](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-chefchaouen-blue-city.html): A full-day shared trip from Fes to Chefchaouen's blue-washed medina, the Kasbah Museum, and Plaza Uta el-Hammam. From €39pp.
- [Essaouira Coastal Day Trip](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-essaouira-coastal.html): A full-day shared trip from Marrakech to Essaouira — UNESCO-listed medina, sea ramparts and the Atlantic fishing port. From €39pp.
- [Ifrane & Middle Atlas Cedar Forest Day Trip](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-ifrane-cedar-forest.html): A full-day shared trip from Fes to Ifrane and the Middle Atlas cedar forest near Azrou, home to wild Barbary macaques. From €29pp.
- [Marrakech Medina Guided Walking Tour](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-marrakech-medina-walking-tour.html): A half-day shared walking tour through Marrakech's medina — Jemaa el-Fnaa, the souks, Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque and the Saadian Tombs. From €15pp.
- [Meknes, Volubilis & Moulay Idriss Day Trip](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-meknes-volubilis-moulay-idriss.html): A full-day shared trip from Fes to Meknes, the Roman ruins of Volubilis, and the holy hillside town of Moulay Idriss Zerhoun. From €29pp.
- [Ourika Valley & Atlas Mountains Day Trip](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-ourika-valley.html): A full-day shared trip from Marrakech to the Ourika Valley — an argan cooperative, Berber villages, and the Setti Fatma waterfalls. From €29pp.
- [Ouzoud Waterfalls Day Trip](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-ouzoud-waterfalls.html): A full-day shared trip from Marrakech to Ouzoud Falls — North Africa's tallest waterfall, Barbary macaques and an optional boat ride. From €35pp.
- [Sefrou & Bhalil Half-Day Trip](https://www.sharedmoroccoadventures.com/daytrip-sefrou-bhalil.html): A half-day shared trip from Fes to the cave houses of Bhalil and the walled medina of Sefrou. Our cheapest day trip, from €19pp.
